assertions.description: The ::interest-button selector parses. This check alone is not proof of support: Chromium 153 parses it even with the feature flag off.
Interest invokers, the parent feature, are present: HTMLButtonElement.prototype has interestForElement.
With author content set, a[href][interestfor] that points at an existing element generates an ::interest-button box. Its 40px inline-size widens the link's line fragments.
assertions.test: (() => { const h = document.createElement('div'); h.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap'; h.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.cf-ib::interest-button{content:"i";display:inline-block;inline-size:40px}'; const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-t'; t.popover = 'hint'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.tabIndex = -1; a.className = 'cf-ib'; a.textContent = 'x'; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-t'); h.append(st, a, t); document.body.append(h); const sum = () => [...a.getClientRects()].reduce((s, r) => s + r.width, 0); const w1 = sum(); st.disabled = true; const w0 = sum(); h.remove(); return w1 - w0 > 30; })()

assertions.description: button[interestfor] that points at an existing element is also a valid interest source and generates the box.
assertions.test: (() => { const h = document.createElement('div'); h.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap'; h.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.cf-ib::interest-button{content:"i";display:inline-block;inline-size:40px}'; const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-t2'; t.popover = 'hint'; const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.tabIndex = -1; b.className = 'cf-ib'; b.textContent = 'x'; b.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-t2'); h.append(st, b, t); document.body.append(h); const w1 = b.getBoundingClientRect().width; st.disabled = true; const w0 = b.getBoundingClientRect().width; h.remove(); return w1 - w0 > 30; })()

assertions.description: A plain link without interestfor is not an interest source, so the same rule generates no box.
assertions.test: (() => { const h = document.createElement('div'); h.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap'; h.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.cf-ib::interest-button{content:"i";display:inline-block;inline-size:40px}'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.tabIndex = -1; a.className = 'cf-ib'; a.textContent = 'x'; h.append(st, a); document.body.append(h); const sum = () => [...a.getClientRects()].reduce((s, r) => s + r.width, 0); const w1 = sum(); st.disabled = true; const w0 = sum(); h.remove(); return Math.abs(w1 - w0) < 1; })()

assertions.description: A link whose interestfor id matches no element is not a valid interest source, so no box is generated.
assertions.test: (() => { const h = document.createElement('div'); h.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:0;top:0;visibility:hidden;white-space:nowrap'; h.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.cf-ib::interest-button{content:"i";display:inline-block;inline-size:40px}'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.tabIndex = -1; a.className = 'cf-ib'; a.textContent = 'x'; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-does-not-exist'); h.append(st, a); document.body.append(h); const sum = () => [...a.getClientRects()].reduce((s, r) => s + r.width, 0); const w1 = sum(); st.disabled = true; const w0 = sum(); h.remove(); return Math.abs(w1 - w0) < 1; })()

assertions.description: HTML UA styles leave ::interest-button content at none, so authors must opt in. Computed content is 'none' on a valid source when no author rule exists.
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.createElement('div'); t.id = 'cf-ib-t3'; t.popover = 'hint'; const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = '#'; a.setAttribute('interestfor', 'cf-ib-t3'); a.setAttribute('data-cf-ib-default', ''); a.hidden = true; document.body.append(a, t); const c = getComputedStyle(a, '::interest-button').content; a.remove(); t.remove(); return c === 'none' || c === 'normal'; })()

assertions.description: Tapping or clicking the ::interest-button box shows interest in the originating link: an interest event fires and the hint opens. The link does not navigate.
assertions.test: Needs a real pointer or touch event on the generated box, and the HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo flag. Exercise it at /v141/the-interest-button-pseudo-element/touch-link-previews/ (the log reports interest and no navigation).

assertions.description: ::interest-button is not focusable, not keyboard-activatable and absent from the accessibility tree. It adds no tab stop.
assertions.test: Needs a Tab walk and an accessibility-tree inspection (DevTools). The edge-cases-and-migration concept counts tab stops; AX tree absence must be confirmed in DevTools.
